title: Englisch 7 Gymnasium (ZAM Academy)
description: English at Bavarian Gymnasium grade 7 (first foreign language): 44 lessons on adverbs, reflexive and possessive pronouns, present perfect progressive, past perfect, conditionals II and III, wishes, North American customs, media, Wales, the Desert South-West and English history from 1066 to the Mayflower, with 132 recall cards. Listening, live talk and current research need extra practice.
